svg.title: Dino Jump · physical wiring layout
svg.desc: Illustrated Arduino Uno, parallel 16 by 2 LCD, breadboard, contrast potentiometer, button and backlight resistor. Pin connections are detailed below.
svg.text: Parallel 16×2 LCD in 4-bit mode • D7 jump button with internal pull-up
USB-powered Arduino Uno · pin names match the sketch
*Use a suitable backlight resistor if absent on the module. Component values are suggestions; see build notes.
